success_patterns: Agents split multi-part requests into distinct calls for independently requested outputs, even when they concern the same subject.
Agents map explicit constraints and values to the matching endpoint fields, including locations, filters, locales, and page numbers.

patch.reasoning: These recurring patterns are already covered by the skill's endpoint-mapping, call-scoping, and argument-building rules. The Breckenridge trajectory's alert-location and units mismatches are isolated here, so they do not support a new batch-wide rule.
